pages.description: Newton Stewart in the Lowland League are carrying out safety checks at their Blairmount Park ground.
pages.text: Toppled trees force Newton Stewart fixture postponement Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Toppled trees force football fixture postponement 27 October 2026 Share Save Add as preferred on Google Newton Stewart FC A tree fell through a perimeter fence and was left hanging over the pitch Toppled trees have forced the postponement of a match in Scottish football's fifth tier on player and spectator safety grounds. Newton Stewart were scheduled to host Gretna 2008 at Blairmount Park in the Lowland League West but the club posted pictures of the scale of the problem being faced. One tree had caused significant damage to a perimeter fence and was lying over the pitch. The club said it was being removed but it needed to get a professional assessment of other trees nearby with high winds expected throughout the day. Newton Stewart FC Safety checks will be carried out at the ground The area around the ground has seen "significant damage" in the past few days due to storms sweeping across the country. The club warned anyone heading up to the area that it might be unsafe until a proper assessment was carried out. At the weekend fallen trees blocked the entrance to the ground and now more have come down next to the pitch. The one overhanging the pitch has been removed but further assessment will be carried out by experts to see if there is a risk of further damage. pages.text: TorchTitan Update: New SOTA Models, Performance at Scale, TitanRL - PyTorch Search Close Search Blog TorchTitan Update: New SOTA Models, Performance at Scale, TitanRL By The PyTorch Team at Meta October 21, 2026 October 22nd, 2026 No Comments Featured projects TorchTitan is a PyTorch-native platform for rapid experimentation and large-scale pre- and post-training of generative AI models. It is designed as a minimal, clean-room implementation of PyTorch-native techniques, with flexible extension points for users’ needs. This has enabled TorchTitan to find widespread adoption across research and production in academia and industry. The TorchTitan team landed massive improvements in the past year, without losing its minimal, extensible ethos. Enhancements include support for SOTA models, dramatic improvements of out-the-box performance at scale, RL support and new communication features. TorchTitan is for everyone – easy to use, providing SOTA performance and allowing users to start small and scale up seamlessly. We will present all these new improvements in the following sections, and we look forward to your feedback! New model support SOTA model support is critical for the success of training frameworks, and TorchTitan aims to always provide the latest advancements when it comes to open-weights architecture. Tori Kelly: Tiny Desk Concert September 10, 2026 5:00 AM ET Ashley Pointer Credit: Photo: Michael Zamora/NPR When Tori Kelly pulled up to the Desk, her band already mid-rehearsal, she immediately got to work and filled our room with her commanding voice. She had arrived. And with her, she carried genuine joy and light. Backed by an all-woman band of Tiny Desk alumnae, Kelly effortlessly moves through songs from her latest album, God Must Really Love Me . The record captures Kelly in the present: reflecting on her faith journey and navigating life as a new mom. She also drops some gems for the day one's, including brief tastes of "Nobody Love" and "Dear No One." But, most serendipitously for the middle schoolers in attendance, Kelly performs her rendition of Stevie Wonder 's "Don't You Worry 'Bout a Thing," the song that her character Meena belts in the animated film Sing . Sponsor Message I've always found Tori Kelly to be inspiring. Beyond her anointing as a vocalist and musician, she has endured the many shifts of the music industry while maintaining an authenticity that cuts through the noise and reaches the heart. There's something special about watching an artist who has grown so much, yet still sounds and feels unmistakably like herself. English Español Français العربية 简中 Русский Cerrar TORTURA Shutterstock/Phase4Studios Volver a Qué hacemos Existe tortura cuando una persona actuando a título oficial inflige dolor o sufrimiento mental o físico grave a otra persona con un fin específico. En unos casos, las autoridades torturan a una persona para que confiese un delito, o para obtener información de ella. En otros, la tortura se utiliza simplemente como castigo que difunda el miedo en la sociedad. Los métodos de tortura varían. Pueden ser de carácter físico, como palizas y descargas eléctricas. Pueden ser de índole sexual, como la violación o la humillación sexual. O pueden ser de carácter psicológico, como la privación de sueño o la reclusión prolongada en régimen de aislamiento. En virtud del derecho internacional, la tortura y otras formas de malos tratos son siempre ilegales. Están prohibidas internacionalmente desde hace decenios. Por poner sólo un par de ejemplos, 172 países se han adherido al Pacto Internacional de Derechos Civiles y Políticos, que prohíbe la tortura y otras formas de malos tratos, y 165 países son Parte en la Convención de la ONU contra la Tortura por cuya creación Amnistía Internacional hizo campaña intensamente. Pero muchos Estados no tipifican la tortura como delito específico en su legislación nacional, y gobiernos de todo el mundo siguen desafiando el derecho internacional al torturar a personas. pages.text: Tottenham Hotspur FC - Transfer news, results, fixtures, video and audio Tottenham Hotspur Latest updates Image source, Getty Images So, in Harry Kane, England has its first Ballon d'Or winner in 25 years. And the newly-crowned world's best player was made in Tottenham. Kane joined Spurs' academy in 2009 and rose through the ranks, including spending loan spells at Leyton Orient, Millwall, Norwich City and Leicester City, making his debut in 2011 and eventually breaking into the first team regularly under Tim Sherwood in 2014. His first opportunities for Spurs came in the Europa League, and on the day he scored his first senior hat-trick in a group stage win over Asteras Tripolis, he ended the game in goal after Hugo Lloris was sent off. Kane became the club's greatest-ever goalscorer, and now the first-ever player to come through the club's academy and go on to win the Ballon d'Or. In his acceptance speech on Monday, Kane said: "I want to say thank you to Tottenham Hotspur, as well. I wouldn't be where I am today without Tottenham, for sure. "I was there from 11 years old. All the guidance, the coaches - you allowed me to live my dream. So, for sure, without all those moments together, all the ups and down along the way of that journey has led me to this moment here today. "So I just want to say thank you to Tottenham Hotspur." Kane also put on record his thanks to a number of his coaches who trained him from his early days in Spurs' academy, as well as key figures at the club. "I want to give a shout-out to some of my coaches that have helped me along the way," he added.

In the wake of their draw with Manchester United , Tottenham headed to Marbella for a few days of warm weather training and, more importantly, squad bonding. "The target is to build the team," head coach Roberto de Zerbi explained. "We are a great group of players, but we are not a team yet." His side certainly looked like more of a cohesive unit at Old Trafford, but their slick approach play was squandered by yet more profligacy in front of goal as their winless start stretched to six league matches. Only two top-flight sides have completed more passes in the final third than Spurs' 770 and just three teams have had more touches in the opposition box than their 182. Yet a shot conversion rate of 3.6% is the worst in the league and De Zerbi's side have underperformed their xG by 3.6 goals. Three goals after six league matches is the second lowest tally in their history, beaten only by the two scored at the start of 2006-07. pages.text: Tourist Trash Has Done Weird Things to Yellowstone's Thermal Pools | National Geographic ENVIRONMENT Tourist Trash Has Done Weird Things to Yellowstone's Thermal Pools For over a century, tourists have discarded objects into the park’s hydrothermal features. Park staff try to remove as much as they can. But sometimes, the litter leaves a lasting impact. Each year, Yellowstone National Park staff collect trash found in the park's hydrothermal areas. This year, the collection included more than 280 hats. Margery Price, National Park Service By Carolyn Wilke Published October 13, 2026 In the 1880s, a visitor to Yellowstone National Park described how the churning waters of a pool not far from Old Faithful would suck a handkerchief down and return it “nice and clean” in a few minutes. Hundreds of visitors dropped their hankies into the warm waters of the Handkerchief Pool as it was known. The pool’s trick stopped working around 1927, and in 1929, a ranger removed kerchiefs, over 100 hair pins, a horseshoe and more from the pool. Handkerchief Pool is no longer accessible by boardwalk, and tossing objects into hot springs is now illegal. But the problem of trash and debris in Yellowstone ’s features persists, as does the park’s efforts to clean it up. This year’s inventory of stuff that’s been thrown, blown or dropped into Yellowstone’s features includes some oddball objects from golf tees to hotel keys and even a tiny copy of The Vampire Diaries . “I think it’s a fascinating window into humanity,” says Margery Price, a geologist with the National Park Service. pages.description: 本页详细说明了支持资金的申请标准与流程，旨在为web社区中代表性不足的群体提供参会所需的经济支持。受助者需同时满足以下条件：因经济原因无法自行承担TPAC参会费用，且有意愿参与TPAC会议并作出贡献。
pages.text: TPAC多元参与基金 | 欢迎参与 | W3C 转到内容 TPAC多元参与基金 计划简介 TPAC多元参与基金旨在帮助降低W3C参与者的参会门槛。本计划主要面向那些已在W3C小组工作中做出积极贡献、展现出持续承诺，但仍需资金支持才能更积极地参与或以更有意义的方式在 TPAC 会议上做出贡献的成员。 本基金资金源自多方支持，包括：W3C成员会费、 社区参与倡导者计划 的赞助以及各方 捐赠 。诚盼您慷慨捐助，鼎力支持。 资格条件 本资助计划面向所有符合以下条件的W3C参与者开放： 申请之前的过去两年内，至少参加过一次TPAC（线上或线下均可） 全年至少参与一个现有的W3C小组 全年出席小组会议方面有良好的记录 践行《 W3C行为准则 》 本计划特别关注需要经济支持方可线下参加TPAC会议，并承诺以实际、深入的方式为W3C技术工作作出贡献的成员。实质贡献可包括但不限于以下形式： 组织分组话题讨论，或为TPAC议程提供重要内容支持； 参与技术规范、文档或测试用例的编写； 撰写供会议讨论的解释性文件、草案等材料； 审阅小组工作并提供反馈意见。 优先资助标准 本基金将优先资助代表性不足的群体，以促进成员在背景、性别、经历、专业领域及技能方面的多元化。 以下群体的申请将予以优先考虑： 来自中低收入经济体； 代表小型机构，或在W3C社区内代表性不足的利益相关方群体及行业； 女性及多元性别身份人士； 残障人士 未在上一轮资助中获得支持的个人 基金资助范围 W3C将为入选申请者提供部分资助。申请者需提供其可能自行承担的费用部分的详细信息。 本基金可资助以下一项或多项符合条件的支出： TPAC注册费 差旅费用：往返TPAC会议的最经济、直接、安全的路线提前预订行程所产生的交通费用。 住宿费用：在会议规定的截止日期前提前预订、以获得优惠房价所产生的住宿支出。 专为出行日期投保的保险费用，涵盖旅行和医疗费用。若入选者已持有当前有效的年度/雇主旅行保险，W3C将不承担该费用，但须提供保单副本作为报销条件。 差旅和保险费用，以及一名额外成年人作为照护者的共享住宿费用（前提是若无该照护者，参与者将无法参会）。照护者亦可免费注册。照护者须在出行期间及活动期间每日提供支持（例如协助参与者在场馆内行动、往返社交活动等）。 W3C通常为所有需照看儿童才能正常参会的TPAC与会者，在现场免费提供儿童看护服务。 申请 申请表用于收集遴选工作所需的信息、确认申请人是否符合申请资格与条件，以及了解其申请资助的理由。所填信息将接受核实。 申请表中还设有一部分，供申请人清晰说明其为支持自身参会而已落实的筹款机制，并披露其他赞助方施加的任何条件，以及因接受此类资金而产生的任何潜在或可预见的利益冲突。 申请人须提供差旅和住宿费用的明确报价。所提方案应清楚体现低成本与便利性之间的平衡（例如更短的航班中转时间，或步行可达场馆的距离），同时保证安全和无障碍要求。 费用估算应明确说明申请人准备自行承担哪些费用，因为该基金也将提供部分资助。 遴选 申请期每年开放一次。申请将由首席执行官任命的委员会进行评估。 除有关合理费用的指南和标准外，以下因素也将纳入评审考量： 拟参会活动前后的任何额外个人旅行费用不属于可报销费用。 若总体上更具性价比，往返日期和地点可作调整。相关计算应纳入预估资助金额中。 申请人须确认：若资助获批，将（按要求）提供更新后的报价，以供支出预批。 申请人须承诺提供注明日期的有效收据以办理报销。提交报销申请时若包含不同币种的收据，申请人应以单一币种提交，并披露所采用的汇率。申请人须确认，所申报的任何费用均未向其他资金来源重复申请报销。 支持“包容性基金”和“特邀专家支持基金” 赞助 赞助方可通过向“包容性基金”和“特邀专家基金”捐款，帮助降低参会门槛，并创造高价值的关系与合作机会。 展现承诺

pages.text: Trabajadores domésticos | International Labour Organization Ir al contenido principal Portal temático Trabajadores domésticos Facebook X Linkedin Índice de contenidos Trabajadores domésticos Cerrar El trabajo doméstico es un trabajo de cuidados, ya es hora de que lo convirtamos en un trabajo digno Las trabajadoras y los trabajadores domésticos prestan servicios de cuidados directos e indirectos esenciales en los hogares o para ellos. A escala mundial, 75,6 millones de personas, en su mayoría mujeres y muchos migrantes, están empleadas en este sector, lo que representa el 4,5 % del total de los trabajadores. A pesar de su papel esencial en el sostenimiento de las familias, las sociedades y las economías, las trabajadoras y los trabajadores domésticos siguen estando muy infravalorados, desprotegidos e infrarrepresentados . En 2021, la OIT constató que el 81 % de ellos trabajaban en la economía informal, lo que pone de relieve las deficiencias persistentes en materia de legislación y aplicación de la ley. A medida que aumenta la demanda de cuidados debido a los cambios demográficos y al declive de los cuidados no remunerados, es más urgente que nunca garantizar un trabajo decente a las trabajadoras y los trabajadores domésticos mediante una remuneración justa, protecciones jurídicas sólidas y una representación significativa. ¿Cuál es la situación de los trabajadores domésticos en su país? ¿Cuál es la situación de los trabajadores domésticos en su país? pages.description: Winding through the Southern Alps in New Zealand, the TranzAlpine is lauded as one of the world’s greatest rail journeys, but few know that its well-worn tracks also trace the path of an ancestral Māori trade route.
pages.text: Tracing Māori jade culture along the TranzAlpine rail route in New Zealand | National Geographic By Justin Meneguzzi Published November 2, 2025 This article was produced by National Geographic Traveller (UK). Te Rua Mason believes finding pounamu is much like finding love. Despite the spitting rain and biting wind, Te Rua, his son Henare and I are picking our way along the pebbled mouth of the Arahura River outside Hokitika township. The steel-grey Tasman Sea crashes and foams against the shore nearby, hurling salty spray into the air. Sky-wheeling seagulls bicker and caw. The weather might be dreary but Te Rua, my guide and founder of Te Rua and Sons Pounamu Trail tours, says it’s a good day to search for pounamu, a type of jade found exclusively on the west coast of New Zealand’s South Island. Too much sunlight can wash everything in an indiscernible glare — rain helps the stone’s natural green stand out among the limestone and quartz. Even with the weather’s help, finding pounamu is a fated encounter, a bit like meeting your soulmate — if it’s meant to be, the stone will find you. Today, it seems, I’m unlucky in love. I show Te Rua an emerald-coloured rock the size of a large apple, but he says the colour is just algae. “Practice makes perfect,” he assures me. An imposing figure with an intricate facial moko (a sacred tattoo that represents his Māori ancestry), my gently spoken guide opens up about his connection to the river as we walk. pages.text: Tracking a Mystery: When and How the First Americans Arrived | National Geographic The Oregon Coast, pictured here, may have been a byway for the first Americans as they followed the nutrient-rich coast southward on foot and by boat, says the new book, Atlas of a Lost World . Photograph by Ty Milford, Aurora BOOK TALK When, How Did the First Americans Arrive? It’s Complicated. The first Americans weren't one group of people; they arrived at different times, and likely by different methods. By Simon Worrall Published June 9, 2018 • 13 min read How did human beings first come to North America? Across the Bering Strait, on foot? Down the “kelp highway” by boat? Across the Atlantic via the polar ice cap? And when did they reach here? 10,000 years ago? 40,000? Or were they always here, as the Navajo and other Native American tribes believe? In his new book, Atlas Of A Lost World , author Craig Childs sets off to test these different theories on the ground, traveling from Alaska to Chile, Canada to Florida. What he finds, despite the best efforts of archaeologists and the latest technology , still remains in many ways a mystery. Speaking from his home in Colorado, he explains why many Native Americans reject the idea that their ancestors migrated from somewhere else; how an archaeologist nicknamed Dr. Poop believes he has identified the first human excrement in America ; and why diversity seems to have been built into America’s DNA. However, progress has slowed during the last decade and billions will still lack access to care and face health-cost-related financial hardship by 2030. Governments must prioritize health in their budgets and spend more efficiently – focusing on reducing reliance on out-of-pocket payments and on providing integrated and high-quality care, especially to manage chronic health conditions more effectively. The Trade by Industry and Product Statistics (TIPS) is an experimental data product that provides granular-level information about the U.S. industries that import and export by type of product. This project is an expansion of another international trade-based data product: the “ Profile of U.S. Importing and Exporting Companies ,” (the Profile) which provides statistics about the U.S. businesses that import and export goods. The Profile links international trade data to industry classification codes and employment size information derived from the Census Bureau's Business Register , the list of all businesses operating within the United States. While the Profile provides valuable information about the characteristics of companies engaged in international trade, it does not include data about the types of goods exported or imported. This is a key piece of information stakeholders can use to understand the supply chain more completely. The TIPS data address this data gap by combining detailed information about the internationally traded goods with the industry-level information from the Business Register. pages.text: Train Travel with Bicycles | National Rail Skip to main content Train Travel with Bicycles Are bicycles and trains the ultimate combination? We like to think so. Both are convenient, environmentally friendly and fun! Here’s what you need to know about bringing your bike on the train. Many train operators allow bikes onboard. On some trains, you need to reserve a space for your bike before you travel. Make sure you check the specific cycle policies for each train company you travel with. You can also park your bike at lots of stations – search our Stations page for more information. In general: Label your bike clearly. Cover folded bikes. Motorcycles, tricycles and bicycle trailers are not permitted. Unaccompanied bikes are not permitted. Bikes must be kept in designated areas and must not obstruct doors or aisles. Bikes are carried at the owner’s risk, see the National Rail Conditions of Travel (PDF, 1.1MB) . Folding bikes You’re welcome to bring your folding bike on all trains, at no extra cost. There are a few additional requirements on the following services: c2c and Stansted Express – folding bikes should be transported in a protective carrying case. East Midlands Railway, South Western Railway and LNER – folding bikes are carried free of charge as long as they can be stowed as luggage. London Overground – folding bikes are carried free of charge, up to a limit of one per vestibule area at peak times. And their curiosity makes journeys more exciting, memorable and fun for adults too. Whether it’s a short hop, a day trip, or taking the family on holiday, train travel with kids is time well spent. Plus, there are loads of discounts for children, and some under-5s can travel for free! Train travel isn’t just a way to get from A to B, it’s all part of the adventure. From spotting signals and stations to the multi-sensory experience onboard, every journey gives children something new to notice, connect with and talk about. So jump onboard with the kids for your next trip, and get precious time to explore together. On the train you can. Train is the bestest way to travel! It’s fast, convenient and stress-free, for animals and owners alike. Here’s everything you need to know about bringing your pet on your journey. You’re welcome to bring up to 2 animals with you, at no extra charge. If you want to travel with more animals than that, there may be an additional fee. Please contact your train company for more information. Leads and pet carriers Both on the train and at stations, we kindly ask you to keep your dog on a lead or in a pet carrier – whichever you and your furry friend prefer. As for other animals (such as cats or birds), please keep them in a pet carrier or similar. Pet carriers must be rigid and not open, to prevent escape. Your pet must be able to stand and lie down comfortably inside the carrier. Sorry, no animals on seats We know, there’s all sorts of exciting things going on outside the windows. But animals are not allowed on seats. Animals on sleeper trains You’re welcome to bring your pet on sleeper trains . Animals are not allowed in restaurant cars, except for assistance dogs. If you’re bringing your dog on a sleeper service, there will be an additional charge for a heavy duty clean, except if you’re travelling with assistance animals. pages.text: Training a 1T-Parameter MoE on EU public infrastructure with PyTorch and TorchTitan - PyTorch Search Close Search Blog Training a 1T-Parameter MoE on EU public infrastructure with PyTorch and TorchTitan By The EUROPA consortium (Domyn, Fraunhofer IAIS and IIS) November 12, 2026 No Comments Featured projects TL;DR Scaling pretraining for a ~1-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model on shared, public infrastructure was previously considered unfeasible due to unique architectural and interconnect bottlenecks. However, by leveraging the fine-grained flexibility of PyTorch and TorchTitan, the EUROPA consortium successfully unlocked frontier-scale training on JUPITER, boosting throughput from 90 to ~1,300 tokens/sec per GPU across 384 NVIDIA GH200 GPUs per DP replica (96 nodes) as part of the EuroHPC Frontier AI Grand Challenge. The EuroHPC Frontier AI Grand Challenge was designed to prove that sovereign, open-source AI could compete at frontier levels using shared public resources. As part of that process, we – as the EUROPA consortium, formed by Domyn and Fraunhofer IAIS and IIS – were selected to an open European Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model of at least 400B parameters, support for all 24 official EU languages, and strict compliance with the EU AI Act. In this post, we describe how we scaled pretraining to 1T MoE on JUPITER , the EuroHPC exascale supercomputer hosted at Forschungszentrum Jülich, proving that public infrastructure can indeed sustain frontier scale. View on TensorFlow.org Run in Google Colab View source on GitHub Download notebook The phrase "Saving a TensorFlow model" typically means one of two things: Checkpoints, OR SavedModel. Checkpoints capture the exact value of all parameters ( tf.Variable objects) used by a model. Checkpoints do not contain any description of the computation defined by the model and thus are typically only useful when source code that will use the saved parameter values is available. The SavedModel format on the other hand includes a serialized description of the computation defined by the model in addition to the parameter values (checkpoint). Models in this format are independent of the source code that created the model. They are thus suitable for deployment via TensorFlow Serving, TensorFlow Lite, TensorFlow.js, or programs in other programming languages (the C, C++, Java, Go, Rust, C# etc. TensorFlow APIs). This guide covers APIs for writing and reading checkpoints. View on TensorFlow.org Run in Google Colab View on GitHub Download notebook This example will work through fine-tuning a BERT model using the Orbit training library. Orbit is a flexible, lightweight library designed to make it easy to write custom training loops in TensorFlow. Orbit handles common model training tasks such as saving checkpoints, running model evaluations, and setting up summary writing, while giving users full control over implementing the inner training loop. It integrates with tf.distribute and supports running on different device types (CPU, GPU, and TPU). Most examples on tensorflow.org use custom training loops or model.fit() from Keras. Orbit is a good alternative to model.fit if your model is complex and your training loop requires more flexibility, control, or customization. Also, using Orbit can simplify the code when there are many different model architectures that all use the same custom training loop. This tutorial focuses on setting up and using Orbit, rather than details about BERT, model construction, and data processing. For more in-depth tutorials on these topics, refer to the following tutorials: Fine tune BERT - which goes into detail on these sub-topics. Any command that accesses the database (basically, any SQL command, except a few PRAGMA statements) will automatically start a transaction if one is not already in effect. Automatically started transactions are committed when the last SQL statement finishes. Transactions can be started manually using the BEGIN command. Such transactions usually persist until the next COMMIT or ROLLBACK command. But a transaction will also ROLLBACK if the database is closed or if an error occurs and the ROLLBACK conflict resolution algorithm is specified. We preserve and provide access to the records of the U.S. government, including the Declaration of Independence, the Constitution, the Bill of Rights, as well as the records of ordinary citizens. Many of the documents at the National Archives are handwritten records such as letters, memos, and reports. By transcribing documents, you can help us unlock history and discover hidden aspects of records and the stories they contain. Best Practices for Transcription Accordion Type what you see All documents are unique and may contain various aspects such as stamps, tables, or charts. Type what you see and follow the order and layout as best you can. Type words exactly as they are written in the document. This includes capitalization, abbreviations, names, dates, and even misspelled words. In 95% of your plotting, you won't need to think about this, as it happens under the hood, but as you push the limits of custom figure generation, it helps to have an understanding of these objects, so you can reuse the existing transformations Matplotlib makes available to you, or create your own (see matplotlib.transforms ). The table below summarizes some useful coordinate systems, a description of each system, and the transformation object for going from each coordinate system to the display coordinates. In the "Transformation Object" column, ax is a Axes instance, fig is a Figure instance, and subfigure is a SubFigure instance. Accessible, reliable transportation ensures that Americans with disabilities can actively participate in the labor force and gain meaningful employment. Public transportation systems have increasingly ensured greater accessibility, but many people with disabilities still can't access transportation to work. Access to public transit and for-hire transportation for people with disabilities includes many aspects of accessibility. The diversity of disability means that transportation needs to consider cognitive, sensory, and physical and mobility access. Improving access to transportation requires travel trainings, coordination of resources, and trainings on rights.
